name: The Maze Escape
author: SirRaidenGalahad
description:
CLICK THE MAZE ENTRANCE TO START

Movement:
W-Forward
S-Backward
A-Turn Left
D-Turn Right
Left shift-Sprint

Abilities:
F-Use foodpack. Foodpacks restore 100 stamina and can be eaten every 10 seconds
V-Drop vinebit. Vinebits can be used to make trails
SPACE-Use weapon

Weapons:
1-Rock. Deals 1 damage
2-Bow. Deals 5 damage. Arrows can be picked up
3-Fish blade. Deals 3 damage. Can only be unlocked by orange vault.

Game rules:
You are a runner in a maze. Your goal is to escape. The obstacles: many. Every 90 seconds, the day becomes night. When night falls... well, you'll figure it out later. Your only hope is to run, and run fast. The rest you'll learn over time. Good luck, and don't smash your face into a wall.

Notes:
This game was made in 5 days. In other words, don't judge. If you make a masterful work of art while your goal was to just make a game in 5 days, do people criticize you? No, cause you did it, so leave me to hide in the hole I've dug myself. Alone.
